title: Mouse Sucks Delivers a new single titled "Way Back"
htmlContent:
Multi-Talented artist Mouse Sucks from Canada reconnected with The Dream Band. They have brought out all their musical talents and aim to incorporate love and innovation in all their projects to move forward and give a voice to those who have none. This Characteristic shines bright with the release of his single, “Way Back.”

Mouse Sucks' “Way Back” is a song about time traveling into the past to fix previous relationships. It’s masterful in its sound and showcases him as the stand-out talent he is, with every facet of his skills being in full bloom, from the strong songwriting. “Way Back” is an ultimate jam that is right on time to make fans of us all.
